## *About Me*

> I am a motivated university student currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree at California State Polytechnic University, Pomona. My academic and professional focus centers on data analytics, digital marketing strategy, and business intelligence. Through coursework and applied projects, I combine analytical thinking with technical tools to solve real-world business challenges and generate meaningful insights.\

> My work emphasizes data-driven decision making, visualization, and performance analysis. I have developed skills using platforms such as Google Analytics 4, Tableau, SAP ERP systems, R programming, Excel analytics, and Quarto web development. I enjoy transforming raw data into actionable insights that support strategic decision making.\
>
> As a multilingual communicator fluent in English, Arabic, and Spanish, I thrive in collaborative environments where analytical problem-solving and teamwork drive innovation. My goal is to continue developing technical and leadership skills while preparing for a career in analytics, marketing intelligence, or business strategy.
